observation: The pointer-field mismatch Shawn saw was real at the time it was pasted, but a prior session (visible in the same pasted transcript, under the src/mcp move) already corrected it in the same edit pass that updated identity.json's identity.role and workspace.app_src_root/app_mcp_root -- it just never got its own sealed trail, so there was no on-disk proof it had happened.
lesson: Multi-field edits inside one identity.json update (role text + workspace roots + governance pointers) should each be checked off in the same trail's check phase, or a partial fix (like the src/mcp move getting a trail while the pointer-field correction did not) will look unfinished even after it's done.
earned_constraint_candidate: When identity.json's governance.note is updated to say a correction happened, the canonical_* fields it references must be checked in the same cycle's check phase -- not assumed correct because the note says so.
